claims.quote: We describe four patients with Dravet syndrome in whom long-term phenytoin therapy reduced seizure frequency and duration.
Reintroducing phenytoin improved seizure control, suggesting phenytoin is beneficial in some patients with Dravet syndrome.
There is, however, considerable debate about the sodium-channel blocker phenytoin, which is often used for status epilepticus, a frequent feature of Dravet syndrome.
